security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, configuration filenames, or TypeScript template literals. Real residual risk is limited to examples that include local environment files in cache inputs and CI release workflows that consume GitHub and npm tokens.

remediation.issue: Local environment files are included in cache dependency patterns.
remediation.suggestion: Avoid broad **/.env.*local inputs when remote caching is enabled, or document that secret values must not be cached or uploaded.

remediation.issue: Release workflow examples pass GitHub and npm tokens into publishing steps.
remediation.suggestion: Pin trusted actions, set minimal workflow permissions, and recommend least-privilege npm tokens with short rotation periods.

content.user_title: Manage Monorepos with Turborepo and Nx
content.value_statement: Large repositories become hard to build, test, and share across teams. This skill guides monorepo setup, caching, dependencies, CI, and package publishing.
actual_capabilities: Plans repository structure for apps, packages, and shared configuration.
Explains Turborepo, Nx, and pnpm workspace setup patterns.
Designs build, test, lint, and type-check task pipelines.
Guides workspace dependency management and package filtering commands.
Provides CI/CD patterns for affected builds and package publishing.
Highlights common pitfalls such as circular dependencies and phantom dependencies.
limitations: It does not inspect private repositories unless files are provided in the workspace.
It does not replace tool documentation for version-specific behavior.
It does not guarantee faster builds without measurement and cache tuning.
It does not manage secrets or publish packages on its own.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Workspace
use_cases.description: Create a practical app and package layout with shared tooling and clear ownership boundaries.

use_cases.title: Improve Build Performance
use_cases.description: Review task pipelines, cache inputs, and affected-project commands to reduce unnecessary work.

use_cases.title: Prepare Package Releases
use_cases.description: Set up changesets, versioning, and CI release steps for shared packages.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Monorepo Tool
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose between Turborepo, Nx, and pnpm workspaces for a repository with two apps and three shared packages.

prompt_templates.title: Design Workspace Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Team needs a concrete layout before implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a monorepo structure for a web app, docs site, shared UI package, shared config package, and shared TypeScript package.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Task Pipelines
prompt_templates.scenario: Existing monorepo has slow builds and tests.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my monorepo task goals and propose build, test, lint, and type-check pipelines with cache inputs and outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Advanced CI Releases
prompt_templates.scenario: Mature workspace needs affected builds and package publishing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CI plan for affected builds, protected package publishing, release pull requests, and token safety in a pnpm monorepo.

output_examples.input: I need a new monorepo for a web app, docs site, and shared UI library.
output: Recommended layout with apps, packages, and shared config areas.
Tool choice guidance for pnpm workspaces with Turborepo task orchestration.
Initial build, test, lint, and type-check workflow steps.

output_examples.input: Our CI runs every package test on each pull request.
output: Cache input review to avoid stale or excessive rebuilds.
Verification checklist for build time and cache hit rate.

output_examples.input: We want to publish shared packages from the monorepo.
output: Package versioning and publish flow guidance.
Token handling notes for secure CI publishing.

best_practices: Start with clear workspace boundaries before adding automation.
Measure build and test times before changing cache rules.
Use least-privilege tokens for any CI publishing workflow.
anti_patterns: Putting every package into the same dependency graph without ownership rules.
Caching secret files or machine-specific files in remote build systems.
Publishing packages from CI without protected branches and scoped tokens.

faq.question: Can this skill help choose between Turborepo and Nx?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares tool fit based on repository size, team needs, task graph complexity, and expected workflow.

faq.question: Does it support pnpm workspaces?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes pnpm workspace setup, filtering commands, dependency installation patterns, and package store considerations.

faq.question: Can it migrate an existing multi-repo setup?
faq.answer: It can plan the migration and review structure. It needs repository details to produce exact file changes.

faq.question: Can it improve CI speed?
faq.answer: It can suggest affected builds, cache configuration, and task pipeline changes. Results depend on repository structure and tool versions.

faq.question: Does it handle package publishing?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers changesets, versioning, publishing steps, and CI token safety practices.

faq.question: Is this only for JavaScript repositories?
faq.answer: The examples focus on JavaScript and TypeScript tooling. Some planning concepts apply to other ecosystems.
